action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/components/sections/SMEsMarquee.jsx line 26: change 'https://miniapps.service' to 'https://miniapps.services' (plural). This is the only spec deviation found in this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py content_overrides collection has no unique index on 'key' — put_content relies on update_one with upsert=True; concurrent PUTs to the same key could theoretically insert two docs. Non-critical (upsert filters by key), but adding db.content_overrides.create_index('key', unique=True) at startup would harden it.

server.py CONTENT_ALLOWED_TAGS includes h1/blockquote/sub/sup/s/i/b in addition to the tags stated in the review spec (spec listed a/strong/em/u/ul/ol/li/p/h2-4). Superset is safe (nh3 still strips everything else) but consider tightening if strict spec compliance matters.

CmsContext.jsx Rich component runs a regex on every string override to unwrap a single

… useMemo/useCallback around walk() would prevent re-rendering the whole tree when only unrelated overrides change; currently walk() re-runs for the entire content object on any override change.

SMEsMarquee.jsx TAG_EXTERNAL is a plain object literal declared at module scope with a typo in the URL — no test guards prevented this. Recommend either adding a unit test or moving external URLs to /app/frontend/.env for env-driven validation.

ContentEditor.jsx does not surface backend 422 errors (invalid key, value too long) to the user beyond a disabled state — clicking Save silently no-ops if backend rejects. Consider a toast/inline error near cms-save-<key>.

rca of the issue: SMEsMarquee.jsx Mini Apps URL typo — root cause is a hard-coded string literal 'https://miniapps.service' missing the trailing 's' in TAG_EXTERNAL dict. Reproduction: visit / at 1920px, click the 'Mini Apps' pill inside the Power for SMEs marquee. A new tab opens to https://miniapps.service which fails DNS (chrome-error://chromewebdata/). Mitigation: change line 26 to 'https://miniapps.services'.
